entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your curses are particularly tenacious.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast a spell or spell-like ability with the curse descriptor, or a special ability with a curse effect.

Benefit(s): Any curse effect you create is difficult to remove.

When a creature makes a caster level check to remove the curse, it must roll twice and take the worse result.
